description: This file defines a GUI component for displaying and interacting with behavior coding maps in the BORIS software. It includes a QWidget subclass with embedded graphics view, methods for loading map data, and functions for displaying maps within the application.

classes.name: BehaviorsCodingMapWindowClass
classes.description: Main widget class for displaying and interacting with behavior coding maps, including nested View class for handling mouse events.

methods.name: loadMap
methods.description: Loads bitmap data from the coding map and displays it with polygons representing areas.

methods.name: closeEvent
methods.description: Handles the window close event, emitting a signal with the map name.

methods.name: eventFilter
methods.description: Filters key press events to send to the main window.

methods.name: mouse_move_event
methods.description: Displays behavior codes under the mouse cursor.

methods.name: viewMousePressEvent
methods.description: Handles mouse clicks on the map, emitting selected area codes.
